mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(mbrla.*) FROM MRT_BUS_RUNG_LOG_ANAL mbrla INNER JOIN bigdata.EXT_GGBIS_BUS_ROUTE gnr ON mbrla.BUS_ROUTE_ID = gnr.ROUTE_ID WHERE 1=1

SELECT gnr.ROUTE_NM , gnr.ST_STA_NM , gnr.ED_STA_NM , mbrla.CLCT_YMD , mbrla.BUS_ROUTE_ID , mbrla.BUS_USER_CNT , mbrla.TRSFR_CNT FROM MRT_BUS_RUNG_LOG_ANAL mbrla INNER JOIN bigdata.EXT_GGBIS_BUS_ROUTE gnr ON mbrla.BUS_ROUTE_ID = gnr.ROUTE_ID WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY TO_TIMESTAMP(mbrla.CLCT_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET (#{page}- 1) * 10

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CLCT_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY') AS "year" FROM MRT_BUS_RUNG_LOG_ANAL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CLCT_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CLCT_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY') DESC

SELECT SUM(MBRLA.TRSFR_CNT) AS TRSFR_CNT -- 환승수 ,SUM(MBRLA.PSGR_CNT) AS PSGR_CNT -- 승객수 ,SUM(MBRLA.BUS_USER_CNT) AS BUS_USER_CNT --,MBRLA.BUS_ROUTE_ID ,GBS.SIDO_CD ,GBR.ROUTE_TP FROM MRT_BUS_RUNG_LOG_ANAL MBRLA INNER JOIN GGBIS_BUS_ROUTE GBR ON GBR.ROUTE_ID = MBRLA.BUS_ROUTE_ID INNER JOIN GGBIS_BUS_STATION GBS ON GBS.STATION_ID = MBRLA.RIDE_BSTP_ID -- 승차정류장 GROUP BY --MBRLA.BUS_ROUTE_ID GBS.SIDO_CD -- 권역별 ,GBR.ROUTE_TP;
